WITH department_counts AS (
    SELECT m2.department, COUNT(*) AS income_count
    FROM income i
    JOIN member m ON i.link_to_member = m.member_id
    JOIN major m2 ON m.link_to_major = m2.major_id
    GROUP BY m2.department
), department_shares AS (
    SELECT department, income_count,
           CAST(income_count AS REAL) / SUM(income_count) OVER () AS share
    FROM department_counts
), above_average AS (
    SELECT department, income_count, share,
           AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
    FROM department_shares
)
SELECT SUM(income_count) AS combined_count,
       AVG(average_share) AS average_share,
       AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM above_average
WHERE share > average_share;
